---
title: "Resources"
---

The papers, open datasets, and software behind the \acr{OPDI} — together with the open-source ecosystem the initiative is built upon.

## Method studies

Each method of the OPDI data has been tested in a study: a report that
compares the method with EUROCONTROL reference data, and says where it works
and where it fails. The [Methods](methods/index.qmd) pages summarise the
results; the studies give every detail. A study can have several versions:
the latest describes the method of release v2.0.0, and the earlier ones are
kept as the record of how it was developed.

| Topic | Latest study | Earlier versions | Summarised on |
|---|---|---|---|
| Which position reports form one flight | [Turning ADS-B state vectors into flight tracks, version 5](../papers/track-construction-v5/index.html) | [1](../papers/track-construction-v1/index.html), [2](../papers/track-construction-v2/index.html), [3](../papers/track-construction-v3/index.html), [4](../papers/track-construction-v4/index.html) | [Track identity](methods/track-identity.qmd) |
| How many position reports to keep | [Thinning state vectors, and what the archive actually contains](../papers/statevector-decimation/index.html) | none | [Trajectory cleaning](methods/trajectory-cleaning.qmd) |
| Departure and destination airports | [Departure and destination aerodromes in the OPDI flight list, version 7](../papers/adep-ades-detection-v7/index.html) | [1](../papers/adep-ades-detection/index.html), [2](../papers/adep-ades-detection-v2/index.html), [3](../papers/adep-ades-detection-v3/index.html), [4.5](../papers/adep-ades-detection-v4/index.html), [5](../papers/adep-ades-detection-v5/index.html), [6](../papers/adep-ades-detection-v6/index.html) (with its [review reply](../papers/adep-ades-detection-v6/reply.html)), [6.2](../papers/adep-ades-detection-v6.2/index.html) | [Departure and destination airports](methods/airports.qmd) |
| Runway, block, surface and vertical events, distance rings | [Flight events from ADS-B, version 4](../papers/flight-events-v4/index.html) | [1](../papers/flight-events-v1/index.html), [2](../papers/flight-events-v2/index.html), [3](../papers/flight-events-v3/index.html) | [Take-off and landing](methods/takeoff-landing.qmd), [Block times](methods/block-times.qmd), [Runway milestones](methods/runway-milestones.qmd), [Airport surface events](methods/surface-events.qmd), [Vertical events](methods/vertical-events.qmd), [Distance rings](methods/distance-rings.qmd) |
| Events that the aircraft's own track contradicts | [Plausibility checks for flight milestones, version 1](../papers/milestone-plausibility-v1/index.html) | none | [Plausibility checks](methods/plausibility-checks.qmd) |
| Holding, point merge and FIR crossings | [Holding, point merge and FIR crossings as flight events, version 1](../papers/airspace-events-v1/index.html) | none | [Holding](methods/holding.qmd), [Point merge](methods/point-merge.qmd), [FIR crossings](methods/fir-crossings.qmd) |
| ADS-C position reports as a second source | [Does ADS-C improve the OPDI results?, version 1](../papers/adsc-effect-v1/index.html) | [ADS-C in the OPDI trajectory, version 1](../papers/adsc-fusion-v1/index.html) | Not used in release v2.0.0 |
| Processing time of one day | [How long one worldwide day takes to process, version 1](../papers/processing-speed-v1/index.html) | none | [Processing steps](methods/pipeline.qmd) |

All studies, with a short summary of each, are listed on the
[studies index](../papers/index.html). Each study page also links to its PDF.

## OPDI Software

Open-source projects created and maintained by the \acr{PRC} as part of the initiative.

:::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang}

**[OPDI](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/opdi)**

The software that produces the OPDI data: a Python package that runs the
processing steps on Apache Spark, from the OpenSky Network's position reports
to the published daily files. [Processing steps](methods/pipeline.qmd)
describes what it does, and the [Methods](methods/index.qmd) pages describe
each algorithm.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/opdi) · [{{< iconify fa6-solid book >}} API reference](https://euctrl-pru.github.io/OPDI/)
:::
::::

:::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang}

**OPDI reader (`opdi.published`)**

A small part of the OPDI package that reads the published daily files into
pandas tables, gives back the table shapes of release v0.0.2, and creates
DuckDB views. It needs pandas, pyarrow and DuckDB, not Spark. See
[Access](data/access.qmd#python) for examples.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/opdi)
:::
::::

:::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-info}
[Airflow]{.pill .pill-lang}

**OPDI daily processing (Airflow)**

The schedule that produces the data: two Apache Airflow workflows, one that
processes each new day and one that processes a chosen range of past days.
They are in the `airflow/` folder of the OPDI repository, with instructions
for running them.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/opdi)
:::
::::

:::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang}

**[HexAeroPy](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/HexAeroPy)**

Determines the airports, runways, taxiways, and stands used by a flight from its coordinates alone. Developed for small-scale applications of the OPDI approach to airport layouts.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/HexAeroPy)
:::
::::

## Open-Source Foundations

Open-source projects from the wider open aviation software community that
OPDI builds on, or that work well with its data.

:::: {.project-card .project-dependency}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang} [MIT]{.pill .pill-licence}

**[traffic](https://traffic-viz.github.io/)**

A toolbox for processing and analysing air traffic data, for example to plot
and analyse the trajectories of OPDI flights.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/xoolive/traffic) · [{{< iconify fa6-solid book >}} Documentation](https://traffic-viz.github.io/)
:::
::::

:::: {.project-card .project-dependency}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang} [LGPL-3.0]{.pill .pill-licence}

**[OpenAP](https://openap.dev/)**

The open model for aircraft performance and emissions, by [Dr. Junzi Sun](https://junzis.com/) of TU Delft. OPDI uses its rules and values to decide the flight phase of each position report (see [Vertical events](methods/vertical-events.qmd)).

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/junzis/openap) · [{{< iconify fa6-solid book >}} Documentation](https://openap.dev/)
:::
::::

:::: {.project-card .project-dependency}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang} [LGPL-3.0]{.pill .pill-licence}

**[pyopensky](https://mode-s.org/pyopensky/)**

The Python interface to the \acr{OSN} database, providing access to state vectors and historical trajectories via the REST API and Trino.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/open-aviation/pyopensky) · [{{< iconify fa6-solid book >}} Documentation](https://mode-s.org/pyopensky/)
:::
::::

:::: {.project-card .project-dependency}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang} [LGPL-3.0]{.pill .pill-licence}

**[fastmeteo](https://github.com/open-aviation/fastmeteo)**

A fast tool for obtaining meteorological data along flight trajectories, for example to add weather to OPDI flights.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/open-aviation/fastmeteo)
:::
::::

## Contributing

If you maintain an open-source project that builds on OPDI data, or would like to contribute to one of ours, we would like to hear from you. Contact us at [pru-support@eurocontrol.int](mailto:pru-support@eurocontrol.int).
